name: Jeush
overview: Jeush was a male member of the tribe of Judah, known specifically as a son of Rehoboam and Mahalath. His identity is primarily established through his parentage, linking him to the royal lineage of Judah. There are no additional unique notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeush is a proper name that may mean "may God aid," reflecting a possible prayer or hope embedded in his name. This meaning is derived from Hebrew and is noted in 2 Chronicles 11:18. There are no titles associated with his name.
familyAndRelationships: Jeush is explicitly recorded as a son of Rehoboam and Mahalath, placing him within the royal family of Judah. Scripture does not provide further family relationships beyond this parentage.
scriptureSignificance: Jeush's significance in Scripture is tied to his position within the house of Judah as a son of King Rehoboam and Mahalath. His mention affirms the continuation of the Davidic line during a critical period in Israel's history. Although not prominent in narrative events, his lineage contributes to the biblical record of the royal family.
